channel.description: An aggregated feed of Technology-related news

item.title: Sony Bravia Theater Trio review: enormous immersive sound for any screen size or room shape
item.description: The Sony Bravia Theater Trio creates the most balanced and immersive soundstage I’ve ever heard from non-surround setup.

item.title: The 2,000-Nit OLED in Apple’s New MacBook Is a Big Deal
item.description: The touchscreen in the new MacBook Pro is crazily bright with very deep blacks. Here's why it's unlike anything else you can currently buy.

item.title: Apple’s touchscreen MacBook Pro pushes laptop pricing to a new extreme
item.description: Prepare to cough up around $14,549 if you want the new touchscreen MacBook Pro to have every upgrade.

item.title: Elon Musk's SpaceXAI hit with multi-million dollar fine for building Mississippi data centers without the right permits
item.description: Mississippi regulators say three SpaceXAI sites began construction without stormwater permits, exposing Musk's company to potential penalties of $6.1 million.

item.title: Huawei FreeBuds Neo review: tiny, fun earbuds only let down by the software situation
item.description: The Huawei FreeBuds Neo are lovely tiny earbuds — but they also sound energetic and aren't too expensive.

item.title: Why the Garmin Fenix 9 Pro is my Fitness Device of the Year award winner
item.description: An all-titanium construction and new software tweaks builds on all the Fenixes that came before it.

item.title: Microsoft just shared Azure’s actual revenue in dollars: $33.2 billion
item.description: Microsoft has never disclosed Azure's quarterly revenue in dollars. But for the first time, we can see just how close it is getting to besting the biggest competitor in the market, AWS.

item.title: A hacker stole more than 40,000 DHS employee records
item.description: A hacker stole a trove of personal information from the Department of Homeland Security (DHS). The breach exposes the names, job titles, phone numbers, email addresses, and office locations of more than 41,000 employees, including those in US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and Customs and Border Protection (CBP), according to TechCrunch and Wired. The […]...

item.title: Google expands AI Search ads globally as core ad growth slows
item.description: The announcement came alongside parent company Alphabet's third-quarter earnings report, which saw revenue grow 25% year over year to $127.6 billion.

item.title: Microsoft recorded $10 billion in revenue from OpenAI
item.description: Microsoft said it made $10 billion in revenue from commercial arrangements with OpenAI, including revenue-sharing payments, in the quarter ending September 30. It underscores the still-enormous financial dependency of the partnership.

item.title: Akai is embracing vibe-coded mods with an open-source MPC
item.description: The MPC Sample Key isn't even formally announced yet, but Akai is already showing off what the modding community is cooking up through vibe coding. item.title: Microsoft hits 10 quarters of record-breaking revenue in a row
item.description: Whatever the future of AI might be, the current situation is still very good for Microsoft. The tech giant reported yet another record for quarterly revenue on Wednesday: $92.3 billion, a 19% increase over the year-ago quarter.

item.title: A budget airline just revealed a startling change in the cost of flying
item.description: Frontier Airlines’ latest earnings show a 71% increase in average ticket revenue per passenger, underscoring the changing economics of discount air travel. Airfares for the cheapest U.S. airline jumped in price this year, but that hasn’t stopped fliers from booking.

item.title: Readwise is taking on Kindle and Kobo for ebook supremacy
item.description: For the last several years, Readwise has been building tools for power readers. There's the eponymous product, Readwise, which stores and categorizes your Kindle highlights to help you remember what you've read. item.title: DuckDuckGo Privacy Pro data removal service review
item.description: An in-depth review of DuckDuckGo Privacy Pro and the features it provides to help users stay secure online.
